description:
Images with agency='CMSA' (135 entries), 'USAF' (20 entries), 'SpaceIL' (11 entries) on the /credits page appear under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section instead of their correct agency-specific sections — because the routing function agencyToSourceId in src/lib/credits-grouping.ts has no mapping for these agency values

Expected: Credits grouping routes each image to the section matching its owning agency/publisher, not its retrieval conduit. CMSA→'cnsa' section, USAF→'us-space-force' section, SpaceIL→a new 'spaceil' section. CFHT (1 entry) and EHT (1 entry) remain unassigned by reporter and correctly fall through to the 'wikimedia-commons' default.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='CMSA' routes to credits section id 'cnsa', not 'wikimedia-commons' or 'solar-system-scope' [reporter: "Group under the existing 'cnsa' section." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='USAF' routes to credits section id 'us-space-force', not 'wikimedia-commons' [reporter: "Group under the existing 'us-space-force' section." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='SpaceIL' routes to credits section id 'spaceil', not 'wikimedia-commons' [reporter: "Create a new source-logo entry for SpaceIL with section id 'spaceil'." (reporter follow-up Q&A)]
- A new source-logo entry with id='spaceil' is added to static/data/source-logos.json with a matching SVG logo at /logos/spaceil.svg (or similar) — the entry must be valid so the section renders on /credits [reporter: Derived from "Create a new source-logo entry for SpaceIL with section id 'spaceil'"; a section needs a source-logo row to render in the credits page layout]
- The mirrored copy of agencyToSourceId in scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts is updated identically to the runtime copy — otherwise the validator will flag CMSA/USAF/SpaceIL entries as cross-source splits and fail preflight [code-invariant: scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts lines 60-80 contain a manual mirror of agencyToSourceId; the validator's own comment ("Kept in sync manually") acknowledges drift. A runtime-only fix causes the validator to detect these entries as routed differently than the old mirror predicts, producing split-bundle false positives.]
- CFHT (1 entry, agency='CFHT') and EHT (1 entry, agency='EHT') continue to fall through to the default 'wikimedia-commons' section — the reporter explicitly declined to route them [reporter: "I don't know." (reporter follow-up Q&A for CFHT and EHT routing)]

Domain facts:
- CMSA (China Manned Space Agency) is the human spaceflight arm of CNSA — the existing 'cnsa' source-logo section is the correct routing target
- USAF (United States Air Force) — the existing 'us-space-force' source-logo section covers US military space activity
- SpaceIL is the Israeli nonprofit behind the Beresheet lunar lander — no existing source-logo matches; a new entry with id='spaceil' is needed
- CFHT = Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (not a space agency; path: fleet-galleries/smart-1/05.jpg)
- EHT = Event Horizon Telescope (path: science/black-holes-m87.jpg)
- The fix is purely in the runtime routing function + its validator mirror + the source-logos data file — no changes to image-provenance.json are needed

Target: src/lib/credits-grouping.ts — agencyToSourceId
